summary: A small 2011 WordPress (iA³ template) home page for FF Ernestine, a wedge-serif text face with an Armenian companion: a header with three link columns, a broadside-style specimen image of justified lines in every style (Latin and Armenian), three columns of about text set in the font, and a link footer. Styles, glyphs, features, the design story and the gallery are separate subpages (not captured). The about block also hides an injected spam paragraph (display:none), a sign the old site was compromised.

instances.look: White header: 'Ernestine.' logo at left; at right three small link columns under pink tracked small-caps headings EXPLORE (Styles, Glyphs, Features), LEARN MORE (About the Design, In-Use Gallery, InfoGuide PDF), GET THE FONTS (Try & Buy); a thin pink rule along the top of the window; on mobile the columns become two dropdowns

A broadside of ten justified lines in black on white, each a different style and size: 'look deeper, not sideways;' (Light), '»→ Learn how to survive a hurricane in your bathtub, smiling', 'STATE YOUR OPINION CLEARLY' (Bold caps), an Armenian line in guillemets, a John Cage quote with small-caps credit, 'sufficiently fluffy*' (Light + Bold), 'Maybe you should give the rocket ship a carport.', a bold-italic puffin fact, Armenian capitals, 'WORLD'S BEST BLUEBERRY STREUSEL CAKE — SINCE 1827' in tracked light caps
instances.ux: The whole image links to the FontFont shop (Try & Buy)
instances.learn: Justify every line of a mixed-style broadside to one measure and fill it with odd, funny sentences: it shows weights, italics, small caps, arrows, quotes and the second script in one dense block

reconstruction.behaviour: none (a GIF image wrapped in a link)
